name: Feng-Pei Clique
people: Xiao He, Cao Can, Zhou Bo, Fan Kuai, Xiahou Ying
people_zh: 萧何、曹参、周勃、樊哙、夏侯婴
summary: Liu Bang's neighbours from Feng and Pei rose with him and became the marquises and chancellors of early Han; their grip on court lasted until Emperor Wen's reign.
summary_zh: 刘邦起兵时的丰、沛同乡，入汉后封侯拜相，汉初丞相多出其中，直到文帝时才逐渐让位于新人。

name: Nanyang Magnates
people: Liu Xiu, Deng Yu, Li Tong, Yin Shi
people_zh: 刘秀、邓禹、李通、阴识
summary: Landed families of Nanyang backed Liu Xiu's rising; they filled the Cloud Terrace generals and supplied Eastern Han's empresses (Yin, Deng).
summary_zh: 南阳豪强地主支持刘秀起兵，云台诸将多出于此，阴、邓等家族又世代出皇后外戚。

name: Hebei Magnates
families: Geng of Shanggu, Liu Yang of Zhending, Guo
families_zh: 上谷耿氏、真定刘杨、郭氏
people: Geng Yan, Kou Xun, Liu Zhi, Empress Guo Shengtong
people_zh: 耿弇、寇恂、刘植、郭圣通
summary: Hebei clans and their cavalry gave Liu Xiu the army to win the empire; Liu married into the Zhending royal house to secure them.
summary_zh: 河北豪族与幽州突骑为刘秀提供了争天下的本钱，刘秀娶真定郭圣通以结好真定王刘杨。

name: Liang Province Generals
people: Huangfu Gui, Zhang Huan, Duan Jiong, Dong Zhuo
people_zh: 皇甫规、张奂、段颎、董卓
summary: Hardened by wars with the Qiang, northwestern commanders formed their own power; Dong Zhuo led them into Luoyang in 189 and broke the Han court.
summary_zh: 与羌人长期作战的西北将领自成一系（凉州三明），189年董卓率凉州兵入洛阳，东汉朝廷由此崩坏。

name: Ru-Ying Scholars
families: Xun, Chen, Zhong of Yingchuan; Yuan of Runan
people: Xun Yu, Chen Qun, Zhong Yao, Guo Jia, Yuan Shao
people_zh: 荀彧、陈群、钟繇、郭嘉、袁绍
summary: Learned clans of Runan and Yingchuan led Han scholarly opinion; they staffed Cao Cao's government and Chen Qun's nine-rank system kept power with such families.
summary_zh: 汝南、颍川名士主导东汉清议，后多为曹操谋臣；陈群创九品中正制，使仕途为世家所据。

name: Qiao-Pei Clique
people: Cao Ren, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Cao Shuang
people_zh: 曹仁、夏侯惇、夏侯渊、曹爽
summary: Cao Cao's kinsmen from Qiao held Wei's armies; Sima Yi's coup of 249 against Cao Shuang ended their power.
summary_zh: 曹操宗族与同乡掌握曹魏兵权，249年司马懿发动高平陵之变诛曹爽，谯沛集团就此失势。

name: Huai-Si Clique
families_zh: 渡江投奔孙氏的江北士人
people: Zhou Yu, Lu Su, Zhang Zhao, Lü Meng
people_zh: 周瑜、鲁肃、张昭、吕蒙
summary: Men from north of the Yangtze who crossed with Sun Ce formed Wu's first generation of commanders and ministers.
summary_zh: 随孙策渡江的淮泗人士，构成孙吴第一代将帅与重臣，此后逐渐让位于江东大族。

name: Four Clans of Wu
families: Gu, Lu, Zhu, Zhang of Wu; Yu, Wei, Kong, He of Kuaiji
families_zh: 吴郡顾陆朱张，会稽虞魏孔贺
people: Lu Xun, Lu Kang, Gu Yong, Lu Ji
people_zh: 陆逊、陆抗、顾雍、陆机
summary: The native southern gentry: pillars of Wu, then second to the northern émigré clans under Eastern Jin and the Southern Dynasties.
summary_zh: 江东本土士族（吴姓），孙吴的柱石；东晋南朝时地位次于南渡的侨姓门阀。

name: Jing Province Faction
families: Jingzhou scholars who followed Liu Bei
families_zh: 随刘备入蜀的荆州士人
people: Zhuge Liang, Pang Tong, Ma Liang, Jiang Wan, Fei Yi
people_zh: 诸葛亮、庞统、马良、蒋琬、费祎
summary: Liu Bei's followers from Jingzhou ran Shu-Han after 214, ahead of the earlier migrants (Dongzhou) and the native Yizhou gentry.
summary_zh: 刘备的荆州班底入蜀后掌握蜀汉中枢，地位高于刘璋旧部的东州士人与益州本土士人。

name: Native Yizhou Gentry
families: Qiao, Du, Zhang, Huang of Ba and Shu
people: Qiao Zhou, Du Qiong, Zhang Yi, Huang Quan
people_zh: 谯周、杜琼、张裔、黄权
summary: Local Sichuan gentry, kept from the top under Liu Zhang and Liu Bei; in 263 Qiao Zhou argued for surrender to Wei.
summary_zh: 巴蜀本地士族，在刘璋、刘备时代都未居要津；263年谯周力主降魏。

name: Émigré Great Clans
families: Wang of Langya, Xie of Chenjun, Yu of Yingchuan, Huan of Qiao
families_zh: 琅琊王氏、陈郡谢氏、颍川庾氏、谯国桓氏
people: Wang Dao, Xie An, Yu Liang, Huan Wen, Wang Xizhi
people_zh: 王导、谢安、庾亮、桓温、王羲之
summary: Northern clans that fled south in 317 settled around Jiankang and Kuaiji; 'Wang and Ma share the realm' — they shared power with the Jin throne.
summary_zh: 永嘉之乱后南渡的北方大族聚居建康、会稽一带，“王与马，共天下”，与东晋皇室共掌朝政。郡望仍称北方原籍。

name: Northern Garrison Army
people: Xie Xuan, Liu Laozhi, Liu Yu
people_zh: 谢玄、刘牢之、刘裕
summary: Xie Xuan raised refugee soldiers at Jingkou; they won at the Fei River in 383, and Liu Yu used them to end Jin and found the Song.
summary_zh: 谢玄在京口招募流民组建，383年淝水之战大胜前秦；刘裕凭借北府兵代晋建宋。

name: Western Garrison of Jing
people: Huan Wen, Huan Chong, Huan Xuan
people_zh: 桓温、桓冲、桓玄
summary: The upstream army at Jiangling rivalled the court; Huan Wen led northern expeditions from it and Huan Xuan briefly seized the throne in 403.
summary_zh: 坐镇长江上游、与建康分庭抗礼的荆州军府；桓温由此北伐，桓玄于403年篡晋称帝。

name: Dai-North Nobility
families: Eight Xianbei noble clans (Mu, Lu, He, Lou...)
families_zh: 鲜卑勋臣八姓（穆、陆、贺、刘、楼、于、嵇、尉）
people: Cui Hao (Han adviser), Mu Chong
people_zh: 穆崇、陆俟（汉臣崔浩辅政）
summary: Tuoba Xianbei nobles around Pingcheng ruled early Northern Wei; Emperor Xiaowen's move to Luoyang in 494 left them behind.
summary_zh: 围绕平城的拓跋鲜卑贵族是北魏前期的统治核心；494年孝文帝迁都洛阳，他们失去中心地位。

name: Shandong Great Clans
families: Cui of Qinghe and Boling, Lu of Fanyang, Li of Zhao, Zheng of Xingyang, Wang of Taiyuan
families_zh: 清河崔、博陵崔、范阳卢、赵郡李、荥阳郑、太原王
people: Cui Hao, Lu Sidao, Cui Qun, Li Deyu
people_zh: 崔浩、卢思道、崔群、李德裕
summary: The 'five surnames, seven houses' east of the Taihang mountains: so prestigious that Tang emperors banned their intermarriage, yet still sought them as in-laws; they faded after Huang Chao and the 905 Baima massacre.
summary_zh: 太行山以东的“五姓七家”，门第之高连唐太宗、唐高宗都要下诏压制、禁其自相婚姻；黄巢之乱与905年白马驿之祸后衰亡。

name: Six Garrisons Clique
people: Gao Huan, Hou Jing, Sima Ziru, Duan Shao
people_zh: 高欢、侯景、司马子如、段韶
summary: After the Six Garrisons revolt, Gao Huan led the frontier soldiers to Jinyang; they dominated Eastern Wei and Northern Qi.
summary_zh: 六镇之乱后，高欢率怀朔等镇军人据晋阳，成为东魏、北齐的勋贵集团，与汉人士族矛盾不断。

name: Guanlong Aristocracy
families: Yuwen, Dugu, Yang (Sui), Li (Tang), Zhangsun; also Wei and Du of Jingzhao
families_zh: 宇文、独孤、杨（隋）、李（唐）、长孙，并吸纳京兆韦、杜等关中郡姓
people: Yuwen Tai, Dugu Xin, Yang Jian, Li Yuan, Zhangsun Wuji
people_zh: 宇文泰、独孤信、杨坚、李渊、长孙无忌
summary: Yuwen Tai fused Wuchuan garrison men with Guanzhong gentry ('Guanzhong-first' policy). This bloc gave rise to Northern Zhou, Sui and Tang; Wu Zetian broke its hold.
summary_zh: 宇文泰以“关中本位政策”把武川镇军人与关陇豪族结为一体（八柱国、十二大将军），先后建立北周、隋、唐；武则天时期遭到打压而解体。陈寅恪提出此说。

name: Guanzhong Clans
families: Wei and Du of Jingzhao; Pei, Liu, Xue of Hedong; Yang of Hongnong
families_zh: 京兆韦、杜，河东裴、柳、薛，弘农杨
people: Pei Ju, Du Ruhui, Wei Zhuang, Liu Zongyuan, Yang Guozhong
people_zh: 裴矩、杜如晦、韦庄、柳宗元、杨国忠
summary: The great houses west of the passes; the Pei of Wenxi alone gave Tang 17 chief ministers, and 'Wei and Du south of the city are a foot and five from heaven'.
summary_zh: 关中与河东的大族。闻喜裴氏在唐代出宰相十七人；俗谚“城南韦杜，去天尺五”。

name: Three Hebei Garrisons
people: Tian Chengsi, Li Baochen, Li Huaixian, Luo Hong
people_zh: 田承嗣、李宝臣、李怀仙、罗弘信
summary: Former An Lushan generals kept Hebei as hereditary fiefs after 763, paying no taxes to the court for 150 years.
summary_zh: 安史降将据河北，世袭节度使、不输贡赋于朝廷，割据约一百五十年。

name: Shatuo Clique
people: Li Keyong, Li Cunxu, Shi Jingtang, Liu Zhiyuan
people_zh: 李克用、李存勖、石敬瑭、刘知远
summary: From their base at Taiyuan, Shatuo leaders founded three of the Five Dynasties (Later Tang, Jin, Han).
summary_zh: 以太原为根据地的沙陀军事集团，先后建立后唐、后晋、后汉三个王朝。

name: Jiangxi Scholar-Officials
people: Ouyang Xiu, Wang Anshi, Zeng Gong, Huang Tingjian
people_zh: 欧阳修、王安石、曾巩、黄庭坚
summary: Through the exams, southerners from Jiangxi rose to lead Northern Song letters and politics, ending northern dominance of court.
summary_zh: 经由科举，江西士人在北宋文坛与政坛崛起，打破了北方人主导朝廷的局面。

name: Luo, Shu and Shuo Factions
people: Cheng Yi (Luo), Su Shi (Shu), Liu Zhi (Shuo)
people_zh: 程颐（洛党）、苏轼（蜀党）、刘挚（朔党）
summary: After the conservatives returned in 1086, they split into three regional factions that quarrelled until the reformers came back in 1094.
summary_zh: 元祐年间旧党执政后，按籍贯分裂为洛、蜀、朔三党互相攻讦，直到1094年新党复起。

name: Han Warlord Marquises
families: Shi of Zhending, Zhang of Shuntian, Yan of Dongping, Li of Yidu
families_zh: 真定史氏、顺天张氏、东平严氏、益都李氏
people: Shi Tianze, Zhang Rou, Yan Shi, Li Tan
people_zh: 史天泽、张柔、严实、李璮
summary: Northern Chinese strongmen who submitted to the Mongols ruled their districts by inheritance; after Li Tan's revolt in 1262 Kublai abolished their hereditary powers.
summary_zh: 归附蒙古的北方汉人地方武装，世袭统治所据州县；1262年李璮之乱后，忽必烈罢世侯、行迁转。

name: Huaixi Clique
people: Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, Li Shanchang, Tang He, Lan Yu
people_zh: 徐达、常遇春、李善长、汤和、蓝玉
summary: Generals and ministers from Zhu Yuanzhang's home region founded Ming; the purges of Hu Weiyong (1380) and Lan Yu (1393) destroyed them.
summary_zh: 朱元璋的淮西同乡构成明朝开国功臣主体；胡惟庸案（1380）与蓝玉案（1393）将其几乎诛尽。

name: Zhedong Clique
people: Liu Ji, Song Lian, Zhang Yi, Ye Chen
people_zh: 刘基、宋濂、章溢、叶琛
summary: Scholars recruited in 1360 who shaped early Ming institutions, rivals of the Huaixi generals; Liu Ji died in 1375.
summary_zh: 1360年受聘的“浙东四先生”，为明初制度建设出力，与淮西集团相争；1375年刘基去世后衰落。

name: Shanxi Merchants
people: Lei Lütai (Rishengchang bank)
people_zh: 雷履泰（日升昌票号）
summary: Rich from supplying the frontier armies and the salt trade, Shanxi merchants later ran China's remittance banks (piaohao).
summary_zh: 起于为边军输粮换盐引，后经营茶叶、票号，汇通天下。

name: Huizhou Merchants
people: Hu Xueyan (late), Bao Zhidao
people_zh: 鲍志道、胡雪岩（晚期）
summary: Salt merchants of Yangzhou and patrons of learning; 'no town without Huizhou men'.
summary_zh: 以扬州盐业为根本，亦贾亦儒，“无徽不成镇”。

name: Donglin Faction
people: Gu Xiancheng, Gao Panlong, Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou
people_zh: 顾宪成、高攀龙、杨涟、左光斗
summary: Centred on the Donglin Academy in Wuxi; they fought the eunuch Wei Zhongxian and were purged in 1625–26.
summary_zh: 以无锡东林书院为中心的江南士大夫，抨击时政，与魏忠贤阉党相斗，1625—1626年遭血腥清洗。

name: Qi, Chu and Zhe Factions
families_zh: 按籍贯结成的官僚派系
people: Shen Yiguan (Zhe), Qi Shijiao (Qi), Guan Yingzhen (Chu)
people_zh: 沈一贯（浙党）、亓诗教（齐党）、官应震（楚党）
summary: Provincial factions opposed to the Donglin; many later joined Wei Zhongxian's eunuch party.
summary_zh: 与东林党对立的地域派系，后多依附魏忠贤阉党。

name: Liaodong Generals
people: Li Chengliang, Zu Dashou, Wu Xiang, Wu Sangui
people_zh: 李成梁、祖大寿、吴襄、吴三桂
summary: Hereditary frontier families who defended Liaodong (the Guan-Ning army); Wu Sangui opened Shanhai Pass to the Qing in 1644.
summary_zh: 世代镇守辽东的将门（关宁军），1644年吴三桂开山海关引清兵入关。

name: Hunan Army Clique
people: Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, Hu Linyi, Zeng Guoquan
people_zh: 曾国藩、左宗棠、胡林翼、曾国荃
summary: Gentry-led militia that crushed the Taiping; its leaders became governors across the empire, shifting power from Manchus to Han officials.
summary_zh: 由湖南士绅组建的团练，镇压太平天国后，其首领遍任各省督抚，地方权力由满人转入汉人手中。

name: Anhui Army Clique
people: Li Hongzhang, Liu Mingchuan, Zhang Shusheng
people_zh: 李鸿章、刘铭传、张树声
summary: Li Hongzhang's army from Hefei succeeded the Hunan army and backed the Self-Strengthening Movement and the Beiyang fleet.
summary_zh: 李鸿章在合肥一带组建，继湘军之后成为清廷支柱，主导洋务运动与北洋水师。

name: Beiyang Clique
people: Yuan Shikai, Duan Qirui, Feng Guozhang, Wang Shizhen
people_zh: 袁世凯、段祺瑞、冯国璋、王士珍
summary: Yuan Shikai's modern army trained at Xiaozhan; in 1912 it decided the end of the Qing.
summary_zh: 袁世凯在天津小站编练的新式陆军，1912年左右了清帝退位与民国初局。
